title: Capital House Lewisham
description: Capital House is a prominent landmark commercial building located in the vibrant centre of Lewisham, offering flexible office suites and ground-floor retail showroom space. Recently refurbished to top commercial standards, the building combines modern open-plan floors with excellent natural light, dedicated lift access, and comprehensive infrastructure suitable for corporate headquarters, professional practices, and high-visibility retail operators.
features: Prominent high street frontage with exceptional footfall
DDA compliant with passenger lift servicing all floors
High-speed Cat 6 data cabling and fibre connectivity ready
Energy-efficient modern air-conditioning and heating
Dedicated secure basement and surface parking spaces
Modern kitchenettes and restrooms on every floor
24/7 keycard access with CCTV security monitoring
Floor-to-ceiling double-glazed windows throughout

title: Belvedere DA17 6AN Mulberry Way
address: Mulberry Way, Belvedere Industrial Estate, Greater London DA17 6AN
description: Situated within the strategically connected Belvedere Industrial Estate, this prime logistics, warehouse and yard facility offers superb versatility for commercial distribution and industrial operators. With generous eaves height, heavy floor loading capacities, and expansive hardstanding yard space for heavy goods vehicle turning and external storage, this property delivers ideal logistics efficiency with immediate connectivity to the A2016 and M25 corridor.
features: Generous 7.2m clear eaves height throughout warehouse area
Multiple full-height electrically operated roller shutter doors
3-phase heavy industrial power supply (up to 400 kVA capacity)
Secure fenced and gated concrete yard with turning circle for HGVs
Integrated two-storey modern ancillary offices and welfare facilities
Unrestricted 24/7 operating hours and site access
Fibre optic broadband connectivity installed
Energy efficient high-bay LED lighting throughout

title: Epping Commercial Complex
address: High Road, Epping, Greater London CM16 4BD
description: Epping Commercial Complex is a premier multi-purpose commercial business park accommodating administrative offices, client-facing showrooms, and spacious workshop/storage facilities under one roof. Ideal for trade counters, design studios, light assembly, or expanding regional hubs seeking high quality premises with extensive dedicated parking and seamless transport connections into Central London via the Central Line.

Extensive dedicated customer and staff parking (over 45 bays)
Fully gated and secure perimeter with round-the-clock CCTV
Comfort-cooling in office suites and high-bay lighting in storage
Short walking distance to Epping Tube Station (London Underground Central Line)
Dedicated loading and dispatch apron with level access
On-site property management and maintained landscaping
Ultra-fast gigabit fibre broadband infrastructure
